title: The State of Generative Media - Gorkem Yurtseven, FAL
talk_summary: This is a market/industry overview of generative media (image/video/audio) from FAL, covering history, ad and e-commerce use cases, and predictions about video model growth. It contains no engineering techniques for agent orchestration, model routing, review quality, or infrastructure.

takeaways.what_they_do: They track usage share shifting toward more expensive video models as capability improves, implying routing decisions weigh capability gains against 20x compute cost rather than pure price.
takeaways.evidence_quote: video models are 20x more compute intensive
takeaways.numbers: video ~20x more compute intensive than image; video usage grew from ~0% to ~30% of platform in months

takeaways.technique: Marginal cost of creation approaching zero
takeaways.what_they_do: Argues that once a creative direction is set, producing the next artifact is near-free, so value shifts to storytelling/consistency.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the marginal cost ofation is approaching zero
